notes.title: Demo Updates and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello!

We've added some fixes to the demo for Monsters are Coming! Rock & Road. 

Let us know if there's anything we've missed. It's all detailed in the patch notes below. 



Fixed joystick dead zone

Fixed input issue that forces the hero to move right when using some specific devices or virtual controllers

Fixed hero death screen (gets stuck when the hero dies after beating the boss)

Fixed possible blocker when closing the pause menu while the warning pop-up is visible 

Fixed softlock when hero dies and levels up at the same time 

Fixed locked camera for the next run after killing the boss while the city is dying 

Fixed disabled 'next button' on end screen which blocks the game



Please do consider leaving us a review if you've enjoyed your time with the game or if this has fixed any issues you've had while playing.



Thanks for all your support



Ludogram and Raw Fury
